data.strFullDescription:
[p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/60042fcfe13af23ebf9633ce309ee540.poster.avif?t=1768388355" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/60042fcfe13af23ebf9633ce309ee540.webm?t=1768388355" width="1170" height="200"][/imgvid][/p][p]使用简洁的类 Python 语言为无人机编程，将枯燥磨人的各式农活彻底自动化。只需轻点“执行”按钮，即可欣赏无人机包揽所有繁重劳动，感受自动化带来的满足与享受。[/p][p]与多数编程游戏不同，本作摒弃了传统的关卡制，并以连贯无缝的曲线成长机制取而代之。[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/b1e7cf50ce1cad6c550963d594e72f30.poster.avif?t=1768388355" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/b1e7cf50ce1cad6c550963d594e72f30.webm?t=1768388355" width="1170" height="400"][/imgvid]

经营你的农场，不断获取资源，并在随后解锁新科技。[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/fa869e0fcff10a9dbe075638052e86bb.poster.avif?t=1768388355" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/fa869e0fcff10a9dbe075638052e86bb.webm?t=1768388355" width="1170" height="400"][/imgvid]

使用类 Python 的简洁语言进行编程。游戏初期，我们将循序渐进，逐一为你引入所有必备的编程基础概念，带你轻松入门。[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/692f455fe7c2acfe1ced5a0a6bae95fd.poster.avif?t=1768388355" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/692f455fe7c2acfe1ced5a0a6bae95fd.webm?t=1768388355" width="1170" height="400"][/imgvid]

游戏将为你铺好基石，但不会牵着你的手走完全程，带你完成任务。面对各式各样的挑战，你必须独辟蹊径，自行摸索答案。对于编程新手而言，这将是一场真正的考验。[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/76478ae4e322491df342bcc6c3a2d32e.poster.avif?t=1768388355" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/76478ae4e322491df342bcc6c3a2d32e.webm?t=1768388355" width="1170" height="400"][/imgvid]

如果你有丰富的编程经验，那么游戏前期不过是牛刀小试，帮你快速热身。真正的大餐，是后期错综复杂，同时又趣味盎然的艰巨任务，它们一定能够点燃你的挑战欲望。[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/25381e2ae2bbf5a0c03f1373396194af.poster.avif?t=1768388355" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/25381e2ae2bbf5a0c03f1373396194af.webm?t=1768388355" width="1170" height="400"][/imgvid]

本游戏所使用的编程语言虽非 Python 本身，但却一脉相承，可让 Python IntelliSense（智能感知）功能大显身手。所有代码均以 .py 文件格式保存，你完全可以选用 VS Code 等外部代码编辑器进行创作。只需开启“文件监视器”设置，游戏便可即时检测外部修改。[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/c49f73206b8411740caeefc559ef36d5.poster.avif?t=1768388355" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2060160/extras/c49f73206b8411740caeefc559ef36d5.webm?t=1768388355" width="1170" height="400"][/imgvid][/p]
data.strSnippet: 编程并不断优化你的无人机，实现农场自动化。安坐一旁，看它为你打理一切；收集资源，解锁更尖端的科技，成为全世界效率第一的农场主。畅享游戏快乐，同时不断提高解决问题和编写代码的能力。
